# LifePower Control v0.3.1

This patch release fixes a job-form regression introduced in `v0.3.0`.

## Job form fix

- Creating and editing saved direct-program jobs now accepts the executable
  and optional arguments submitted by the browser without requiring the hidden
  shell-command field.
- Creating and editing saved shell jobs now accepts the command submitted by
  the browser without requiring hidden direct-program fields.
- The same correction applies to ad-hoc direct and shell execution forms.
- Unexpected fields, repeated fields, and missing active-mode fields remain
  rejected. The complete no-JavaScript form path remains supported.

Failed `v0.3.0` submissions were rejected before storage, so existing saved
job definitions were not modified by this defect.

## Compatibility and safety

The supported hardware and operating-system scope, state schema, installer
behavior, dependencies, hardware safeguards, and power-control boundaries are
unchanged from `v0.3.0`. Ordinary tests remain hardware-independent.
